notes.title: Construction Simulator – Update #14 available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/ff3a7ad784a5252132ffbe8003e545642e0abea6.jpg[/img]

With Update #14 we are excited to bring you new exchangeable parts for the Wacker Neuson ET145 and EW100 excavators, plus a number of bug fixes and general improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. So, pick the perfect bucket for your task and start digging!


[b]Patchnotes - Update #14:[/b]

[b]Exchangeable buckets on Wacker Neuson excavators:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can change the bucket in the context menu in the new “buckets” section when sitting in the associated machine. The following buckets can now be used on these machines:
[list]
[*] ET145: Backhoe Bucket 600 with Teeth, Backhoe Bucket 900 with Teeth, Ditch cleaning bucket 2000
[*] EW100: Backhoe Bucket 600 with Teeth, Backhoe Bucket 900 with Teeth, Ditch cleaning bucket 1500
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes and game improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugfixes regarding Achievements:
[list]
[*] There was a bug that caused Achievements that were dependent on playing time to be unlocked too late or not at all. After a long search, this bug has now been fixed.
[*] In addition, security checks at the launch of the game have been integrated in the software's background.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Some PC players were experiencing an issue where they could get stuck in the start screen (press any key) and not being able to start the game. This has to do with a corrupted UserData. A mechanism that recognizes this issue and recreates the UserData after confirmation has been implemented.
[/list]
[list]
[*] General bugfixes and improvements, among other:
[list]
[*] The voice chat display is now hidden in photo mode.
[*] A floodlight that was blocking the crane area in an EU single-family home contract was moved.
[*] Fixed further bugs that caused vehicles to falsely shoot in the air when using fast travel via the map.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Several minor vehicle fixes and improvements, among other:
[list]
[*] Fixed flying windows on Hamm compactor H11i.
[*] Fixed the joystick of the JCB 220X excavator clipping through the windshield.
[/list]
[/list]

Have fun and stay safe on the construction sites!

Your Construction Simulator team

notes.title: Construction Simulator - Update #11 now available for download!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/3f17bcb0348a12c3a37fe35f0a77795060f627ac.jpg[/img]

Good news: We just released Update #11 for Construction Simulator on PC, PlayStation and Xbox! For the first time in the history of the game series, the update opens the possibility to work together with players on other platforms in multiplayer and, if desired, communicate together via the new in-game voice chat. Another new feature are the new emotes for the players' characters! And not to forget: For mobile excavators, it is now possible to switch between driving and functional mode without resetting the body, boom and bucket! And…of course, there are also numerous fixes and general game improvements too!

[u][b]New Feature: Crossplay Multiplayer[/b][/u]
[b]Added crossplay[/b]: It is now possible to join multiplayer sessions from any platform – regardless, if you are playing the PC version on Steam, the Microsoft Store version or on PlayStation or Xbox.
[list]
[*] Added option to disable crossplay functionality in the settings under ONLINE. Crossplay is enabled by default for all platforms
[*] When creating a multiplayer game, crossplay can be enabled or disabled for that particular session
[/list]

[u][b]New Feature: Voice Chat[/b][/u]
[b]Added voice chat for all platforms[/b]: Most related settings can be found under AUDIO > VOICE CHAT (only appears in-game, not in the main menu):
[list]
[*] Option for enabling/disabling voice chat
[*] Option for changing the audio output and input devices
[*] Option for setting voice chat volume
[*] Radio sound effect when players are far away from each other (can be deactivated)
[*] Possibility to block/unblock communication with other players
[*] Option for activating/deactivating push-to-talk
[*] Option to assign the button for push-to-talk under CONTROLS > HUD/MENU. Default key on a keyboard is “Left Alt”
[/list]
[i]
Note: There are still some known issues regarding this new feature. We are working on them and will try to fix them in the future, but we can't make any promises yet.
[list]
[*] Voice chat quality is frame rate dependent and can therefore be poor on last-gen devices
[*] Last-gen-devices have issues with the voice chat sound after activating the microphone test in the audio settings. This can be fixed by restarting the game
[/list]
[/i]

[u][b]New Feature: Emotes[/b][/u]
[b]Added player emotes for the player’s characters in the game[/b]
[list]
[*] In the context menu, there is a new sub-category called EMOTES
[*] Each emote can also be assigned to a specific shortcut under CONTROLS > CHARACTER
[*] Some emotes are played as one-shot animations, after which the character will automatically return to their normal position
[*] For some emotes, the character will remain in a certain pose, until a new movement input is made
[/list]

[u][b]Mobile Excavator Improvements[/b][/u]
It is now possible for wheeled hydraulic excavators to switch between driving and function mode without resetting the body, boom and bucket. Wheeled hydraulic excavators can now be used in the following ways:
[list]
[*] Driving while the shovel is filled with bulk
[*] Driving while transporting cargo
[*] Transporting a concrete bucket and pouring concrete while driving
[*] Rotate the body 180° to enable rear wheel steering
[/list]

[u][b]Multiple Vehicle Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Final changes on the amount of bulk material which excavator and dumpers can hold
[*] and many small fixes and improvements
[/list]

[u][b]General Game Improvements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Some graphical fixes and improvements
[*] A number of general bugfixes and improvements
[/list]

We wish you lots of fun on the construction sites!

Your Construction Simulator team

notes.title: Construction Simulator – Update #10 available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/91970e9cb3233ee1213ac0388d0402ae7357e2eb.png[/img]

We just released the latest update for Construction Simulator. In addition to bug fixes and general game improvements, Update 10 also introduces a differential lock function to most vehicles which helps in situations where a vehicle is stuck by increasing traction on rough surfaces.


[b]New Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added differential lock to most vehicles:[/b]
[list]
[*] The differential lock helps in situations where a vehicle is stuck by increasing traction on rough surfaces. However, it increases the turning radius depending on the vehicle. The differential lock is not intended for use at high speeds and disengages automatically when driving faster than 15 km/h
[*] The default keybinding is Y on QWERTY keyboards or Z on QWERTZ keyboards
[*] For other input devices the action for the differential lock can be assigned in the keybinding settings
[/list]
[/list]


[b]Vehicle fixes and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Asphalt pavers now have fewer problems with slopes and ramps and don't get stuck as often
[*] The blade on all motor graders can now be lowered further
[*] And many more smaller fixes
[/list]

[b]Other game improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added various animals to the Spaceport setting
[*] Visual improvements in the Spaceport setting
[*] Cargo Ghosts now give a stronger visual indication of where a hooked cargo should be placed
[*] Improved behavior of cargos when hooked and moved with cranes
[*] Fixed a bug in the Spaceport Greenhouse mission where activating the construction view while excavating led to a game crash
[*] Bug fixes and improvements in jobs
[*] General bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

Have fun and stay safe on the construction sites!

Your Construction Simulator team

notes.title: Update #9 is available for download!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/3a6b3fe262bdce2696acc6e0f83c931dd2d9d992.jpg[/img]

We just released the latest update for [b]Construction Simulator[/b]. In addition to bug fixes and general game improvements, [b]Update 9[/b] introduces a new tool for your construction worker: a flashlight! 🔦 We also focused on improving terrain simulation and upgraded the vehicle hall capacity: You’re now able to store up to 500 vehicles.

Watch the release trailer here:
[previewyoutube=fUYDtzha4Hs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Patch notes – Update #9:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a flashlight to the player
[list][*] The flashlight can be activated and deactivated via the context menu[/list]
[*] It is now possible to own and store more than 100 vehicles in one company
[*] Replaced Google Analytics with Unity Analytics
[*] Added offline profanity filter. Inappropriate words will be filtered, e.g. in the names of multiplayer sessions
[*] Server Region Changes
[list]
[*] USA South Central region was added[/list]
[*] Major earthworks improvements
[list]
[*] Completely reworked multiplayer synchronisation for earthworks. Terrain is now simulated locally for the client which makes it smoother to work on
[*] Improved terrain physics: heavy impacts of any source now deform and flatten the terrain. This reduces the frequency of vehicles getting stuck
[*] Driving over terrain slightly compacts it which prevents it from sliding as easily
[*] Improved unloading of bulk materials. The material is now applied in more detail and looks better
[*] Fixed issue where bulk would not fall out of dumper even if hatch is open
[*] Fixed issue where it was possible to create bulk material by digging in undiggable ground
[*] Various optimisations allow the construction view of terrains to update in near real time
[*] Fixed issues where the construction view would show the wrong colors on terrains
[*] Fixed construction view of cargo grid
[*] Fixed various construction site desyncs
[*] Fixed some instances where vehicles would fly into the air when entering while on a construction site
[*] Fixed issue where clients did not leave skid marks on construction sites
[*] Improved performance of inactive machines with bulk material
[*] Various performance and memory optimisations of the earth physics
[*] Many more bug fixes regarding terrain
[/list]
[*] Vehicle fixes and improvements
[list]
[*] Improved digging depth of many excavators
[*] Adjusted amount of bulk material which excavator and dumpers can hold. The volumes are now more realistic and depend on the size of the loading area or the excavator bucket
[*] Improved drilling with rotary drills
[*] Fixed issue where Case 1021G was able to remove earth indefinitely without the shovel filling up
[*] Fixed an issue where the MAN TGS/LH HTM 904 concrete mixer had the functions of a service vehicle
[*] Added collision check when resetting vehicles for excavators and rotary drills
[*] Fixed some cases where machines and characters would jump to the same spot and get stuck 
[*] Improved the stability of vehicles on trailers
[*] and many more fixes and improvements[/list]
[*] Multiple fixes for multiplayer
[list]
[*] Fixed many issues where players wouldn't be able to join a multiplayer session
[*] Initial multiplayer synchronisation when joining a game is significantly faster in many cases
[*] Fixed issue where multiplayer synchronisation lasts forever and the gate at the company never opens for the client
[*] Fixed some cases where cargos would disappear for clients
[*] and many more small fixes
[/list]
[*] Bug fixes and improvements in jobs
[*] General bug fixes and improvements
[/list]
Have fun and be safe on the construction sites! 👷

Your Construction Simulator Team

notes.title: Construction Simulator – Update #4 is available for download!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/af842e051d37cd68dbe3632c2cbb83e08cab4f43.png[/img]

Good news: We just released Update #4 for Construction Simulator! Next to a number of bug fixes and game improvements this update introduces a dedicated task assignment screen within the job planning section for multiplayer sessions as well as some major improvements when using a dozer. Here are the detailed patch notes:

[b]Construction Simulator – Update #4[/b]

[b]Fixes and game improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new dedicated task assignment screen in job planning section
[*]New input actions (shortcuts) were added for some functions which were only accessible through the radial menu
[*]Machines without indicators do not show UI indicators anymore
[*]Reduced memory load in different parts of the game to prevent crashes  
[*]Improved loading of scenario
[*]Multiple multiplayer fixes regarding forklifts and cargo objects
[*]Fixed a number of multiplayer desync issues
[*]Fixed CAT 745C spilling lots of material when auto-filling
[*]Numerous issues were fixed that could cause soil to appear or disappear when digging or dozing
[/list]

[b]Dozing Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now use dozers to push gravel and sand without losing material
[*]The resistance of the soil is now simulated. The dozer will slow down depending on the amount being pushed. The CAT D8T can push the most soil at once but lacks the ability to yaw the blade. 
[*]Depending on the selected job scope it is more challenging to flatten areas with the dozer
[*]You can disable this behavior completely by using the gameplay setting “simplified leveling”. If disabled, you will have to manually push all the soil out of the area which needs to be flattened. Alternatively, you can pick it up with loaders and dumpers.
[/list]

Your Construction Simulator team
https://updates.construction-simulator.com/

[*]Fixed problem with the UFO cargo in USA map tutorial
[*]Improved traffic system
[*]Fixed speed camera trigger speeds
[*]Traffic lights switch faster now
[*]Localization fixes

[*]Tutorial is now skippable
[*]Camera movement with sticks is now possible for Saitek Heavy Equip Farming Sim Controller
[*]Camera controls can now be customized in the controls settings (for gamepads, joysticks and steering wheels)
